verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox environment. The closest evidence is indirect isolation: the agent can create git worktrees and branches, so changes stay off the main working copy (gh-5). Write commands ask for approval once per session and destructive commands always ask (docs-3, gh-6). These are permission guardrails, not a sandbox, and the full-permissions toggle can turn them off. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or isolated execution environment, separation of test data from production data, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
